_doc: Allowlist for scripts/check-name-hygiene.py. Every rule needs a reason. {T} in 'context' stands for the matched token, so rules never spell a denylisted name. A temporary rule sets expires (YYYY-MM-DD) and a tracking reference; the check warns once that date is past. Remove the rule in the change that resolves it.

allow.reason: Canonical repository URL/slug. Changes only if the repository is transferred to a neutral organization (separate decision).
CODEOWNERS must name the real maintainer handle to work.
Copyright, README and plugin authorship names are a maintainer decision handled outside this hygiene change (pending). Name detectors only, so e-mail and other PII detectors still scan these paths.
Historical CHANGELOG entries are a record of the past and are not rewritten; new entries follow the hygiene rule (reviewed in PR).
temporary: files owned by the open git-cycle-sentinel PR #515, which applies the same substitution map. Remove after it merges.
temporary: handled by the separate privacy PR (third-party data and personal contact). Remove after it merges.
temporary: integrity-hashed fixture (manifest digests and embedded identity hashes); editing it breaks verification. Regenerate with synthetic accounts, then remove this rule.
temporary: path references to the signed fixture directory above. Removed together with signed-wacli-fixture.
Synthetic PII test vectors for the PII linter itself (generated, checksum-valid by design).
Public support/role address of a third-party open-source project cited in market research; not personal data of a private individual.
Fictional home path and SSH alias used by the check's own unit test (e-mail and CPF vectors are assembled at runtime).
